prompts.dock_prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one production sprite sheet for a monochrome e-ink maritime trading game, Crosswinds. Create a 1024x1024 sheet with four TINY isolated pen-and-ink dock illustrations, a 2-by-2 grid of unmarked 512x512 cells. Each drawing itself should occupy ONLY about 90 pixels wide and 70 pixels tall at the actual output resolution, centered in its cell, with enormous empty margins. These are miniature book engravings, not pixel art, not cartoons. Crisp black ink, restrained fine hatching, clean white interior surfaces, transparent exterior background; no shadows, border, labels, numbers or text. Same viewpoint and same modest nineteenth-century coastal timber pier in all four cells, three-quarter view from the water, unmistakable pilings, planks and a tiny dockside storehouse. Top left: planned dock, a few shoreline stones, stacked timber and survey stakes. Top right: building dock, a short pier with exposed pilings and partly laid planks, shed timber framing. Bottom left: finished pier with timber storehouse and bollards, NO flag. Bottom right: exactly the same completed dock with one modest dark triangular company pennant attached to the shed. Preserve architecture and perspective between stages. The tiny drawings must be actual tiny drawings in a largely empty sheet, do not enlarge to fill cells; our game crops them WITHOUT RESIZING into slots no larger than 128x112. Keep all subjects smaller than that.
prompts.captains_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create one production miniature portrait sprite sheet from the reference image. Preserve all SIXTEEN captains in exactly the same row-major 4x4 order, their gender, age, ethnicity, hair, headwear and clothing. Traditional serious maritime book engraving character, black ink with clean white interior shapes, expressive faces, no pixel-art or cartoon restyling. Critical change: use a 1024x1024 canvas split into sixteen invisible 256x256 cells, but each portrait itself occupies ONLY about 60 pixels wide by 72 pixels high, centered in its cell with enormous empty transparent margins. Each needs to be redrawn thoughtfully as a miniature at that size, not a big portrait filling the cell. These subjects will be cropped and blitted WITHOUT RESIZING into 96x112 slots. Keep all sixteen far apart. NO labels, lines, circles, borders, numbers or typography. Transparent exterior, solid white within faces and coats where paper is shown. Full bust and hat fit inside each tiny subject. The entire sheet should be mostly empty space. Retain the reference characters and illustration style.
prompts.mapships_prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single production sprite sheet of FIVE MINUSCULE sailing-vessel map markers for a monochrome e-ink chart. 1024x1024 canvas, invisible evenly spaced 5 columns in one row, centered at y=512. Each drawing ONLY about 18 pixels wide by 14 pixels high, extremely tiny compared with the huge empty sheet. Final drawing must fit within 32x26 actual pixels without resizing. Ordered left to right: single-masted sloop with triangular sail; two-masted schooner with fore-and-aft sails; two-masted brig with square sails; three-masted merchant barque; broad three-masted galleon. Broadside profile, bow to right, clear dark hull and white sails outlined with crisp black ink. Small nautical chart engravings with carefully simplified silhouettes, each unmistakably a ship. Transparent exterior. No sea, waves, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or decorations. Do not enlarge drawings to fill the image; more than 98 percent of canvas should be empty. Native tiny silhouettes, minimal rigging chosen for legibility at this actual small size.
